plan.order: AB on odd pairs, BA on even pairs
plan.reason: Original native series: pooled median 4.528% slower, median paired reduction -0.495%, 6/12 faster pairs, range -22.15% to +14.82%. Investigate native timing variation before retaining or rejecting candidate.
plan.policy: Keep all original and follow-up samples; report original, follow-up and combined results separately. No source, binary, timer, workload, resource or power changes. No builds or competing GPU work.

native_followup.interpretation: Original qualification, prospective follow-up and pooled descriptive combination are reported separately; no samples or outliers omitted.

selection.reason: Retained for consistent aggregation improvements in all seven paired comparisons: median time reductions of 1.71% for four inputs, 4.03% for eight inputs, and 2.07% for two concurrent eight-input jobs. Matched NTT event time fell 9.42%. Native timings have a small observed cost: the original pooled median was 4.53% slower, the fixed twenty-pair follow-up was essentially flat (+0.09% reduction), and the combined thirty-two-pair median was 0.49% slower (median paired regression 0.45%; 13/32 faster pairs). No native speedup is claimed. Qualification GPU peaks fell by 212 MiB for four inputs and 296 MiB for concurrent jobs, with a 66 MiB increase for single eight-input jobs; all resource budgets passed.
selection.scope: Tested V100 aggregation and native wallet workloads; no Apple or production qualification

correctness_argument.scope: First radix-2 butterfly fused with global input loads; no field arithmetic changes
correctness_argument.indices: For butterfly b: t=2*(b>>log_c), lc=b&(C-1), tl=t*C+lc, th=tl+C. These equal the original k=1 indices; pairs partition the entire tile.
correctness_argument.twiddle: At k=1, j=0 and powers[0]=1 for every valid root/table configuration. The twiddle is therefore powers[inner].
correctness_argument.synchronization: Every workgroup has uniform lt. For lt>1 a local-memory barrier publishes the twiddle before all threads read it. Every thread completes its global loads and tile writes before the existing tile barrier publishes first-stage outputs. Later stage barriers are unchanged.
correctness_argument.aliasing: Intermediate in-place groups read all their assigned global inputs before any final global stores. Existing disjoint group partitions, separate first input and bit-reversed final destination contracts remain unchanged.
correctness_argument.bounds: No new buffers or local words; host admission, padding, launch dimensions and lt=1 fallback remain unchanged.
correctness_argument.gate: Both LATTICA_NVIDIA_FIELD_CARRY and LATTICA_SHARED_NTT required; existing field gate selects NVIDIA V100 SM7.0.
correctness_argument.checks: Integer NTT and direct-DFT oracles, all-element comparisons for large transforms, existing expanded NTT test across admission/fallback settings, complete proof CPU audits.

fallback.scope: All fallback combinations without both V100 field-carry and shared-NTT guards; token-exact preprocessed source

research.application: Investigate redundant shared-memory traffic and barriers while retaining barriers needed for inter-thread communication. Volta independent thread scheduling forbids relying on implicit warp lockstep; no such assumption is introduced. Occupancy and complete-proof timings determine retention.

initial_experiment_failure.status: experimental correctness failure corrected before timing
initial_experiment_failure.failure: load variant, rows 1024 width 55, forward, forced shared path
initial_experiment_failure.cause: The original barrier after global loads also publishes outer powers. Fusing a butterfly with those loads reads the power earlier, so the experiment needs a barrier before that read.
initial_experiment_failure.fix: Add a workgroup barrier before the fused-load path reads powers[inner]. The condition lt>1 is uniform across the workgroup.

timer_boundaries.four: Aggregation call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, output and CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.single: Cohort launch through worker exit; includes initialization, barrier, aggregation, output and shutdown; excludes CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.concurrent: Cohort launch through last of two worker exits; includes both initializations, barriers, aggregation, output and shutdown; excludes CPU audits.
timer_boundaries.wallet: Native ABI proving call plus GPU drain; excludes initialization, buffer setup, output and CPU audit.

limitations: One Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB, fixed aggregation fixtures, fixed resource budgets and unchanged 250 W cap.
Three four-input pairs, two single eight-input pairs, two concurrent pairs and twelve original native pairs, followed by twenty prospective native pairs; limited sample counts.
Warm alternating pairs; first-use profiles and warmups retained and excluded from qualification medians.
Both pooled median and within-pair reductions reported; short native calls are sensitive to timing variation.
Event totals and inclusive host spans are nonadditive. Uncovered intervals do not establish GPU idle time.
Sampling can miss short-lived native GPU allocations; a sampled zero is not zero actual VRAM.
No cold-cache, Apple GPU, full-block or production qualification.
